name: Preloader
author: Alobaidi

sections.description:
Preloader shows a loading screen while your page loads, then fades it out once everything is ready. Pick a lightweight CSS template or use your own GIF or PNG image, choose where and for whom it appears, and you’re done.

Features

  1. Easy to use – set up your preloader in just 3 steps.
  2. Choose from a collection of free, lightweight templates built with HTML and CSS3.
  3. Customize the templates: background color, fill color, and scale, with a live preview.
  4. Or use your own GIF or PNG image, and customize its size and background color.
  5. Select where to show the preloader (entire site, blog page, posts, pages, categories, tags, author pages, WooCommerce pages, etc).
  6. Choose who sees the preloader: everyone, visitors only, or logged in users only.
  7. Works with any WordPress theme – no need to re-integrate after theme updates or changes.
  8. Compatible with all major browsers.
  9. Lightweight and optimized for performance. Each template is no more than 2KB.
  10. Clear documentation and helpful FAQ section.

Preloader Premium

Want more? Preloader Premium turns your preloader into a smart loading screen:

  • 80+ templates, including Typing Effect (show a message or a coupon while the page loads) and Real Percentage (real loading progress).
  • Image animations for your GIF or PNG image: Spin, Swing, Flip, Pulse, Heartbeat, Bounce, Float, and Fade.
  • 7 fade effects: Fade Out, Slide Up, Slide Down, Zoom Out, Circle Reveal, Circle Expand, and Blur Out.
  • Delay Before Fade and Fade Speed: keep the preloader on screen as long as you want.
  • Cookie-based display: show the preloader once per visitor, then again after a set number of days. GDPR compliant.
  • Device targeting: mobile devices only, any device except mobile, iPhone, iPad, or Android.
  • Always or never show the preloader on specific content by their IDs.
  • Specific WooCommerce pages and custom post types.
  • Hide the preloader on a specific screen width.

sections.installation:
Installation & Configuration

  1. Upload the ‘the-preloader’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Preloader menu > General tab and enable the preloader.
  4. Go to the Templates tab to choose one of the free templates and customize its colors and scale. Or, go to the Image tab to upload your GIF or PNG image, then choose “Your Image” in the Templates tab.
  5. Go to the Display tab to select where to show the preloader (entire site, posts, etc), and choose who sees the preloader (everyone, visitors only, or logged in users only).
  6. Save changes.
  7. Clear your site’s cache if you’re using a caching plugin.

Finally, if the preloader doesn’t show, click on the “Integration” tab, and follow the instructions there.

For common issues and helpful tips, check the FAQ tab.

Usage Guide

sections.changelog:
2.1

  1. Added 5 new free templates: Expanding Circle, Rotating Lines, Wave Dots, Dual Ring, and Circle Scatter.
  2. Added “Author Pages” to the display locations.
  3. Added PNG image support (GIF and PNG are supported).
  4. New “Image” tab with a live image preview.
  5. Redesigned settings pages: “Go to Selected” and “Top” buttons in the Templates tab, and a questions list in the FAQ tab.
  6. Improved security, performance, and compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

All your settings are kept. After updating, please clear your site’s cache if you’re using a caching plugin (e.g., WP Super Cache), so the new improvements work correctly. Enjoy!

2.0.2

  1. Improved performance.

The plugin is now faster with improved performance. After updating, no action is required on your part.

2.0.1

  1. Optimized plugin initialization.
  2. Added a new menu icon.

After updating, no action is required on your part. Enjoy!

2.0.0

  • Everything has changed in this version! Explore it yourself.
  • Go to the Preloader menu > General tab, enable the Preloader and adjust your settings.
  • For common issues and helpful tips, go to Preloader > FAQ tab.
  • How to Use v2.0.0

1.0.9

  1. Fixed header.php file URL in settings page.
  2. Improved preloader performance in JavaScript.

1.0.8

  • Preloader Image Size Extension is ready!

1.0.7

  • Added < noscript > tag in to hide preloader when JavaScript is disabled.

1.0.6

  • Fixed preloader delay issue.
  • Note: After updating, please go to Plugins menu > Preloader and add the preloader HTML element after the body tag in your theme’s header.php file.

1.0.5

  • Fixed script location – all scripts now properly loaded in head tag.

1.0.4

  1. Added support for Front Page.
  2. Added support for 404 Error Page.

1.0.3

  • Added conditional JavaScript loading.

1.0.2

  1. Fixed critical issue.
  2. Added new display location settings (homepage only, posts only, etc.).
  3. Added PHP file protection.
  4. Added uninstall functionality.

1.0.1

  • Removed is_admin() function.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
